nodes.label: Captio CRM (ES) - Case Detail Modal: Distribuidora Nexo Comercial S.A.P.I. de C.V.
nodes.description: UI screenshot of the Captio CRM (Spanish locale) showing a case/client detail modal dialog titled 'Distribuidora Nexo Comercial S.A.P.I. de C.V.' with subtitle 'Negocios / contrato'. Displays a multi-step status workflow: Invitado, Nuevo (active/highlighted in blue), En revisión, Consulta agendada, Revisión de conflicto, Cliente aceptado, Rechazado, Cerrado. The modal includes a 'Respuestas del cliente' section with a 'Generar resumen' AI button and 'Eliminar' action. Client basic information shown: full name 'Distribuidora Nexo Comercial S.A.P.I. de C.V.', occupation 'Empresa — Distribución y logística', email 'legal@nexocomercial.mx', phone '+52 55 7700 4400', birth date 'N/A', identity document 'RFC NCO210315AB3'. A 'Resumen del caso' section is partially visible. A timeline section shows 'Cliente demo generado' event on 4/6/2026, 1:01:18 p.m. A text input field at the bottom allows adding notes/events. Background shows Captio sidebar with navigation items: Nuevo Cliente, Clientes, Bases de dato, Archivos.

nodes.label: Feature: AI-powered Case Summary Generation (Generar resumen)
nodes.description: The 'Generar resumen' button with an AI icon in the case detail modal allows users to auto-generate a summary of the case from client responses.

nodes.description: The Línea de Tiempo section in the case modal shows chronological events, e.g. 'Cliente demo generado' on 4/6/2026, 1:01:18 p.m. Users can add new timeline entries via a text input field.
